notes: Soest, Kerkplein: white/red ANWB cycle fingerpost at right. Lines are the two left-pointing fingers (place names + km). The two right-pointing fingers below ('...mersfoort 8 / ...oestduinen 5', '...oesterberg 8 / ...rnhem 55') are angled and their first letters are partly hidden by the pole clamps, so they are left out. Distractors: blue cycle-path roundel with junction-route plate '67 / PROVINCIE UTRECHT', church tower. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

attribution: Photo: m66roepers from Nederland, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Door_de_dijkcoupure_naar_Eemshaven_(34151928763).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Low-angle film photo of a levee gate (dijkcoupure); target is the blue-bordered white place-name sign at right. Above it an older tilted place-name sign 'Eemshaven / gem E?msmond' whose second line is partly hidden by a post. Distractors: 'drempel' sub-plate under a warning triangle, priority roundel, warning-triangle panel. Cyclist seen from behind (incidental). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
